training_source: Exact official CHEN11-fpocket dataset list pinned in benchmarks/p2rank.lock.json; 251 rows, expected 241 unique PDB IDs. This name denotes a dataset, not 11 proteins.
training_chain_scope: Conservatively include every deposited protein entity in every listed training PDB, including entities beyond the chain selected by the original training path; record this overinclusive scope. Archive all chain-level domain annotations.
candidate_chain_scope: All deposited protein entities for context; entity 1 is the fixed candidate receptor construct. Inspect domain-level CATH/SCOP annotations for every entity; primary candidate comparisons use entity 1 and each annotated recognition-domain sequence where coordinates/boundaries permit.

sequence_screen.algorithm: Smith-Waterman local affine-gap alignment; BioPython PairwiseAligner 1.86
sequence_screen.alignment_selection: First highest-score alignment in the pinned implementation, with target/query ordered by stable record IDs. Store coordinates for complete replay; equal-score alternatives are not claimed unique.
sequence_screen.identity_denominator: Residue-residue aligned nongap columns; exact canonical amino-acid equality, excluding ambiguous X/B/Z from identity numerator
sequence_screen.coverage_denominator: Full length of the shorter compared sequence. Numerator counts shorter-sequence residues in aligned nongap columns; inserted residues aligned to a gap do not contribute.
sequence_screen.unusual_residue_policy: Retain canonical sequence snapshot; map U/O/other symbols outside BLOSUM62 to X for alignment only and report counts. Unknown/ambiguous matches cannot count as identities.
sequence_screen.interpretation: Operational homology warning, not a calibrated statistical homology test. Short matches, repeat-rich proteins, missing domain boundaries, and sequence-negative results require domain/structure interpretation. No candidate is certified novel merely because it fails this screen.

structural_screen.primary_key: Exact four-level CATH homologous-superfamily ID, e.g. 2.60.120.200
structural_screen.additional_flags: Shared CATH first-three-level topology and SCOP2 superfamily/fold labels are separately reported, not silently equated to homology. Multidomain proteins retain each domain and source boundary evidence.
structural_screen.strict_novel_family_primary: No credible sequence-homology warning and no exact CATH homologous-superfamily match to development; recognition-domain assignment and adequate source coverage must also be available. Sequence-screen negative plus missing classification is unknown.
structural_screen.training_status: Mark method-specific seen/novel-under-screen/unknown separately from development holdout. Exact PDB, credible sequence hit, or CATH homologous-superfamily match gives seen; absent/partial training domain provenance gives unknown. All-PDB-entity matching is conservative and may overflag a training chain that was not used.

claims: No universal model-training-held-out claim; audit covers the declared P2Rank default-model CHEN11-fpocket protein list only. Feature tables, probability score calibration, GNINA and other learned methods need separate provenance audits. ProtGlycanDock exact overlap already recorded in the fixed candidate inventory is retained.
